The '''Widows of Alderaan Educational Consortium''' was an educational organization from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was active during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It sponsored the [[Baobab Merchant Council]]'s compilation of the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', which was written by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] scholar [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="GPBaTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Widows of Alderaan Educational Consortium was mentioned in the [[2001]] [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], which was written by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="GPBaTG" />
